name: Emilio Starr
life: “I still remember being paid to arrange things I couldn't arrange for my family.” On Friday, near the corner by Juniper Tailor, Emilio looks at the things people actually bring in for repair before looking in the display window.
voice: I owned a care agency and thought four hours was simple. My dad taught me the order of fifteen little things.
appearance: Emilio has a gray streak running back from the forehead, a flat bridge to the nose and a mobile brow, and a favorite piece of clothing, a cream pullover. It usually goes with a replacement button a shade darker than the others. When somebody else has the floor, Emilio steadies a cup with both hands while listening.
personality: Emilio has a quick wit and an equally quick sense of shame. A joke is often Emilio's way of finding out whether a room is friendly enough for a serious question.
agenda: To learn the father's routine from him.
family: Nicholas Mitchell is Emilio’s cousin raised in the same household. When a relative became too weak to cook, the family started chopping at the kitchen table with the cook directing from a chair. Revising the seasoning remained a point of honor. Emilio will argue about the seasoning like a proper guest. Asked about *The broken till*, Nicholas says, “My prepaid meal card wouldn't work. A stranger trusted me to pay it forward at breakfast.”
connections: Rae Stein. An experienced care manager learns the routine beside a pupil doing homework at Gran's.

reactions.situation: The carer's Wednesday relief calls in sick
reactions.response: Emilio tells the carer plainly how much of Wednesday can still be covered.
reactions.asWritten: The carer's Wednesday relief calls in sick. Emilio tells the carer plainly how much of Wednesday can still be covered.

reactions.situation: A diner goes silent in the middle of a noisy family celebration
reactions.response: Emilio takes a small plate to the quieter end of the table and saves the seat beside it.
reactions.asWritten: A diner goes silent in the middle of a noisy family celebration. Emilio takes a small plate to the quieter end of the table and saves the seat beside it.

reactions.response: Emilio seeks out the person it hurt before telling anybody why it was supposed to be funny.
reactions.asWritten: If the joke lands badly, Emilio seeks out the person it hurt before telling anybody why it was supposed to be funny.
